explanation_excerpt: These skills are built specifically for Claude Code's plugin system, so they only really function there — other AI coding tools like Codex or Cursor would need their own separately-written skill files

gaps.description: Factual error: claims skills only function on Claude Code and require separately-written files per tool. The pack uses the agentskills.io standard, which is explicitly platform-agnostic.
gaps.corpus_ref: MISCONCEPTION: skills only work on Claude Code

gaps.description: Missing coverage of the dual-format distribution model: skills/ as the agentskills.io source of truth versus .claude-plugin/ as a Claude Code-specific enhancement layer.
Missing coverage of cross-platform installation mechanics: install-skills-flat.sh installs the same skill directory to all detected platforms without rewriting.

transfer_problems: A teammate wants to use the react-entity-crud skill in Cursor instead of Claude Code. Walk through what happens to the underlying SKILL.md file, whether it needs to be rewritten, and what installation step is required.

Explain why .claude-plugin/ is described as containing symlinks rather than original files, and how this relates to a skill being usable both as a portable agentskills.io skill and as part of the Claude Code plugin distribution simultaneously.
